request.text: I'm leaving a café near Gare du Nord. Give me directions to my airport hotel—the booking might be by Charles de Gaulle or Orly; I can't remember which. Start with the first turn.

responsibilities.outcome: Provide accurate directions from the café near Gare du Nord to the user's booked airport hotel.

interpretation_unresolved: The booked hotel and its airport location are unresolved between Charles de Gaulle and Orly.

semantic_facts: The planner should ask which booked airport hotel is intended because Charles de Gaulle and Orly imply materially different routes.
No first turn or partial route should be supplied until the destination is resolved.
forbidden_claims: The assistant guesses which airport hotel the user booked.
The assistant claims that navigation or physical movement has begun.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A planner resolves a consequential destination ambiguity by choosing the most salient place name.
A planner leaks an executable first step before obtaining the missing destination.
